summary: This bill bars institutions of higher education from receiving any Department of Homeland Security funds if they have a contract, agreement, donation, or gift from a Confucius Institute, Thousand Talents Program, or Chinese entity of concern, unless the institution ends the relationship or the Secretary grants a one-year national security waiver after consulting the Director of National Intelligence.

scores.thoughts: This bill restricts federal funding to institutions of higher education that maintain relationships with certain Chinese entities. This directly impacts the funding available to these educational institutions, potentially leading to less spending on public higher education if they choose to maintain those relationships.
